target.summary: Symbol back-references in `read_class_name` are resolved against an isolated cache of class names rather than Marshal's global symbol table. A crafted payload containing earlier symbols can cause the validator to verify a permitted class while `Marshal.load` resolves the index to a disallowed class and invokes `_load`, leading to unsafe deserialization.
notes: isolated symbol cache for class name back-references rather than the global symbol table
symbols in the stream are not registered in the symbol cache, desynchronizing symbol table indices
call site of read_class_name when validating custom serialization
call site calling safe_load relying on permitted class validation
